statement: The rules below are frozen. No statistic of the returns of the strategy has been computed or seen on 1993-2025, and the test and sealed files have not been opened. The test sample is opened once per version, by the code and on the inputs hashed here.

rules.samples: test = return months 1993-01 to 2025-12; development = 1981-01 to 1992-12 (not out of sample, never a result). Each sample starts from a book that is all cash.
rules.main_result: version A, boosted trees, all sizes, first-day execution, order cap of 10 % of the ADV, net of half spread and price impact and before commissions, 1993-2025: alpha against the five Fama-French factors and momentum (Ken French files), Newey-West t-statistic with 6 lags
rules.versions: A (market characteristics) is the main conclusion; B (market and accounting characteristics) is a complement, run later through the same frozen scripts; its forecasts must come from the frozen prediction script. No rule is reopened after A is seen.
rules.models: gradient-boosted trees (main), ridge regression (robustness); both reported whatever they give
rules.universes: all eligible stocks (main); eligible stocks at or above the NYSE 20th percentile of market equity
rules.selection: bought if in the top 10 % of the forecasts (NYSE breakpoints, discrete quantile) and at least one characteristic observed; kept while in the top 20 %; stocks tied with a breakpoint are all in; a stock held with every characteristic missing can be reduced, not increased (D18); a stock held that leaves the universe or is no longer eligible has a target of zero
rules.weights: value weights (market equity of t) over the stocks to hold; no cap on a weight; concentration reported
rules.execution: orders frozen with the data of t; filled at the close of the first trading day of t+1 only if CRSP records a closing trade price (TR), a positive volume and no delisting (D13); sales before purchases; a sale cannot exceed what is held; purchases paid with the cash available and all reduced by one factor if it is short; unfilled purchase: cash; unfilled sale: position kept
rules.capacity: constant nominal capital of USD 100 million; order capped at 10 % of the ADV, the smaller of dolvol_21d and dolvol_126d at t, both required (without them the order is zero). The cap of 10 % is a capacity scenario: no source validates a fill of that size at the last trade of the day; the result with a cap of 1 % is shown next to it.
rules.costs: half spread on each amount filled (D14: quoted; else high-low if ranges were observed; else the mean of the eligible stocks of the same size group and month; the highest group mean of the month if the stock has no size group or its group has no donor) and price impact lambda x sqrt(amount filled / ADV) per dollar, on the amount really filled after any reduction of the purchases, lambda 0.025 nano and micro, 0.015 small, 0.010 large and mega, 0.025 without a size group (D22). No commission in the main result (D15).
rules.returns: the book held earns the first-day return; a position earns (1 + ret) / (1 + ret_d1) - 1 for the rest of the month; unknown return of a stock held: full write-off (D16); a stock with no row the following month leaves the panel and its value goes to cash (D17); cash after the trades earns the risk-free rate of the month; gross return = net return + costs of the month
rules.comparisons: secondary and fixed here: the ten configurations (two models, two universes, close-to-close execution, order cap of 1 %); commission stress of USD 0.06 a share until December 2004 and 0.04 from January 2005 on the same fills; gross against net; sub-periods 1993-2008 and 2009-2025; version A against version B
rules.evaluation: regression of the excess return (over the risk-free rate) on CAPM, FF3, FF5 and FF5 + momentum, Ken French factors, Newey-West with 6 lags and no small-sample correction; mean of the return minus the market (FF3 market factor) with the same t-statistic; one conditional diagnostic for the main configuration on 1993-2025: the six factors and their products with the share of the fund invested at the previous month end, centred on its mean (computed the same way for version B when it is run)
rules.factors_rebuilt_from_our_data: rule D20 is postponed: not part of this test; if done later it is secondary
rules.sealed: predictions_<version>_choices_sealed.parquet is opened after the test results are written, to report the values chosen at the edge of their grid

trials_on_the_development_years: 2026-11-13: with the order cap of 1 % of the ADV (rule of 2026-11-12) the fund stayed 72 to 85 % in cash on 1981-1992. Caps of 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 25 and 100 % were compared on the cash share, the turnover and the costs. The simulator produced monthly returns for these runs, as it always does; no statistic of performance was computed, printed or looked at to choose the cap. The project owner chose 10 %, with 1 % as the stress test.
2026-11-13: the alpha script was run on the development backtest to check that it runs; it computes its regressions and writes and prints none of them.
